title: Sudden Expressway Gridlock
description: A heavy container trailer develops a flat tyre along the corridor. Traffic crawls to an absolute standstill as horns echo under the bridge.

effects.message: The unbearable delay drains 10 Energy, but you gain 5 XP enduring the heat.

title: Bumper Passenger Rush
description: Three fully loaded commercial buses discharge waves of thirsty, hungry commuters right in front of your spot.

effects.message: Fast sales earn you ₦2,500 and boost local Respect by +1!

title: Light Cut & Genset Scramble
description: The national grid suddenly snaps off. In seconds, the entire block erupts in the synchronized roar of small tiger generators.

effects.message: You chip in ₦800 for fuel to keep the evening lights and fans running.

title: Sudden Tropical Downpour
description: A swift torrential rain pours across Oshodi. People pack under shop verandas and bridge walkways while gutters roar with stormwater.

effects.message: Soaked sandals and puddles cost you 10 Energy waiting out the storm.

title: Warm Street Banter & Snack
description: A respected elder from the street hails you warmly, sharing fresh fried puff-puff and encouraging your honest hustle.

effects.message: Fresh food and hearty laughter restore +15 Energy and raise Respect by +2.

title: Task Force Routine Sweep
description: A municipal monitoring vehicle drives past the corridor at snail pace. Hawkers step onto walkways and drivers double-check their permits.

effects.message: Tense moments raise street Heat by +1 as everyone keeps a low profile.

title: Generous Patron Tip
description: A hurried business commuter appreciates your sharp, courteous service and hands you crisp currency notes with a warm smile.

effects.message: You receive a handsome ₦3,000 tip and gain +1 Respect!

title: Newspaper Stand Debate
description: A crowd of impassioned citizens debates football and current affairs around a roadside newsstand.

effects.message: Engaging street analysis earns you +1 Respect and +10 XP in local knowledge.
